title: Don't Swim in GTA 6: Something Deadlier Than Gators 😱
youtube_title: Don't Swim in GTA 6: Something Deadlier Than Gators 😱
youtube_description:
Don't swim in GTA 6. Rockstar's own page for Grassrivers, the GTA 6 swamp, says the gators are not the deadliest thing in it: "The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves." It also says: "You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse."

What are those predators? Rockstar doesn't say. Down in the Leonida Keys, Rockstar warns you are "right on the doorstep of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in all of America."

Our best guess, and it is only a guess: the real Everglades hides invasive Burmese pythons (National Park Service). Rockstar has not said there are pythons in GTA 6, and this video does not claim there are.

So, what do you think is down there? One word.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

- Rockstar Games, Only in Leonida: Grassrivers and Leonida Keys (quotes above): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/grassrivers (read November 1, 2026)
